summary: In this transcript, Alex Hormozi argues that **the rapid advancement of artificial intelligence represents the most significant paradigm shift in business history**, urging individuals and companies to **treat AI adoption as their absolute top priority** to avoid becoming obsolete. The speaker stresses that **human labor's economic value will eventually approach zero**, meaning workers and entrepreneurs must pivot from traditional role-based management to **deconstructing tasks into automated workflows driven by custom-trained AI agents**. Furthermore, because most people **suffer from complacency and delay learning new skills**, those who proactively experiment with technology gain **disproportionate operational leverage and a massive competitive advantage** over passive market participants.
